full_judgment: 3. Mr. Md. Noor Hossain Chowdhury, learned Advocate, appearing for the petitioner, submits that, registered deed cannot be cancelled by administrative order. Learned Advocate elaborately submits that registered deed has sanctity and if there 100's of frauds be committed in getting the registered deed the proper course open is to file suit for its cancellation not by administrative order. If this type of administrative order be passed then nobodies’ registered deed would be safe. Learned Advocate relied on the case of Jobeda Bewa and others Vs. Md. Abdur Razzaque reported in 26 BLD (AD)-271 wherein it is held that "it is settled principle of law that nothing short of a decree of a competent civil Court can undo a registered document. If such type of cancellation of a registered instrument is allowed to continue, there will be no sanctity of any registered instrument."
